# KODA

> KODA is a web design studio in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We design and build fast, mobile friendly websites for small and medium businesses, and we run AI SEO and ad campaigns so a business can be found on Google and in AI answers such as ChatGPT and Gemini. We also set up Google Business Profiles. Every website includes managed hosting with SSL, backups and monitoring, and support after launch.

## Facts
- Name: KODA (also written "KODA Web Design" or "HeyKoda")
- Location: Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We serve Durban, Umhlanga, Ballito, Pinetown and Westville, and work with clients remotely.
- Contact: hello@heykoda.co.za, phone 084 999 7601 (+27 84 999 7601)
- Website: https://www.heykoda.co.za/
- Free offer: a free homepage mock-up before you pay anything.

## Services
- Website design and redesign
- Ecommerce stores
- Online booking systems
- Logo and branding
- Google Business Profile setup
- SEO optimisation, and SEO with social media
- AI SEO and ad campaigns: AI-powered SEO and ads that help a business get found on Google and in AI answers such as ChatGPT and Gemini (no ranking or result is promised)
- Website maintenance (updates, backups, security monitoring, small changes)

## Prices (South African rand, once off)
- Starter: R3,499. One page website, WhatsApp button and contact form, Google Maps, basic SEO and AI SEO setup, managed hosting, Google Business Profile setup. Typically 5 to 7 working days.
- Business: R7,999. Five page website, photo gallery and testimonials, on page SEO and Google indexing setup, AI SEO setup (FAQ and business markup, AI-readable summary). Typically 2 to 4 weeks.
- Custom: from R14,999. Online booking or online store, advanced SEO and AI SEO strategy, AI ad campaigns as quoted, custom integrations. Timeline agreed with the client.
- Monthly plans (Presence from R1,499, Growth from R2,999, Performance from R4,999 a month, month to month) cover updates and changes, ongoing SEO and AI SEO, and a monthly report. Performance adds AI ad campaign management, including Google Ads. We do the updating for the client; there is no editor to learn.

## Honest limits
- We cannot promise a particular Google ranking.
